text:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — Acme Corp renewal hits next Wed. They want pricing tier lowered to Pro from Enterprise for 12 months, procurement asking for PO timeline. Need decision on sign path.
Maria Lopez: noted. Do they accept net30? They asked for net45 earlier.
Jordan Patel: PO will come from Acme EU entity; vendor code mismatch possible. Will need billing alias update.
Alex Chen: @Jordan can you confirm vendor code by EOD? If it differs we need legal loop.
Jordan Patel: Yes, vendor code is ACME-EU-02. Procurement will attach PO by Friday. They requested Docusign routing to CFO only.
Samir Rao: FYI — onboarding checklist shows 60% completion, training scheduled next Tue. If we reduce tier, feature access changes; will that impact onboarding?
Maria Lopez: Good catch @Samir — we need to communicate feature set change in enablement session. I'll update the enablement slide and ping CSM playbook.
Alex Chen: Docusign note: they want a single signer (CFO) and wet-sign for EU entity. Is that a blocker?
Jordan Patel: Legal prefers e-sign. @Alex can you ask procurement if wet-sign required for their internal policy? If so, extend signature window by 7 days.
Alex Chen: pinged procurement — they replied: "EU legal requires original signature for >$250k." Amount is 300k so wet-sign required.
Maria Lopez: That delays execution. Can we offer interim access upon PO received and provide provisional onboarding?
Samir Rao: We can grant provisional access with limited tokens. Need internal approval from ops. I'll open a quick approval thread.
Alex Chen: Great. Also capture feedback from their CSM: they've requested more fine-grained token reporting.
Maria Lopez: I'll add that to the renewal notes and send a short survey post-onboard.
Jordan Patel: I'll coordinate vendor code and confirm final signer name. ETA Fri COB.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. Action items: Jordan confirm vendor & signer by Fri COB; Samir open ops approval for provisional access; Maria update enablement slides + survey; I'll draft amendment for wet-sign path and share with legal.
DocuSign Bot: Docusign envelope created by Alex Chen — envelope ID 0a12b3c; routing set to CFO. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Alex Chen: adding note — if wet-sign blocks, fallback: ship countersigned PDF via secure courier.
Maria Lopez: copy. I'll inform customer on expected timeline and next steps. :thumbsup:
